RECOMMENDATION: DON'T RAISE IT
LIKELIHOOD: 0

Both you and the successful candidate are men, meaning sex was not a differentiating factor in the hiring decision. Raising the panel's all-male composition would not support a claim of sex discrimination and would undermine your professional credibility.

An all-male panel in structural engineering typically reflects historical industry demographics rather than bias against male applicants. The firm appears to have prioritized client relationships and commercial skills over additional years of technical experience. 

When following up on your request for written feedback, focus on interview performance, business development, and strategic leadership fit rather than the panel's gender composition.
